parity_golden.json is the frozen answer of the Python ic_finalize producer (capture_ic_finalize_golden.py). Its bytes are not changed; the departures of the Go port are declared in parity_golden_test.go.

CHAOS-14105: the Go port writes every git row of a person (one row per repository and person of the day) with its own git values and no work item, and puts the person's work items on the person's synthesized no-repository row (SynthesizedRepoID), for every person. The reference put them on the person's one git row (delivery_units = merged pull requests + completed items). In this golden, alice is that case: her git row is the recorded row less her 4 completed and 2 open items (delivery_units 7 -> 3), and her synthesized row holds the items (delivery_units 4). The test derives these rows from the recorded one (departWorkItemsToTheNoRepositoryRow) and pins that the person's totals are the recorded ones (assertPersonTotalsMatchGolden).
